title: Radial Component Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the radial component B_r(r, z) as -nu B_0 r z.

title: Current Density Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the current density j(r, z) as -1/mu_0 nu B_0 r e_theta.

title: Use of Maxwell's Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Maxwell's equation to relate the magnetic field components.

title: Assumption Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student must justify the assumption that B_z(r, z) approximates B_z(0, z) for small r.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the calculations of B_r and j.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for the magnetic field.
